observations: B is pixel-identical to formal Feng Idle frame 0; the small head and wide body are canonical, not a slicing or registration error.
KB2 still has Gu-side hanging hands, narrow parallel legs, and a dark broad jacket; B has a screen-left finger at the chin, a screen-right fist, a wide stance, and a bright tailored jacket.

The existing chain reads as progressively shrinking the head and widening a Gu silhouette, then suddenly switching to a fully posed Feng. B is a valid idle pose and a pixel-exact idle handoff, but not a suitable final transformation pose for this chain.
limits: Static evidence cannot prove that all possible future hand-drawn morphs would fail.
The current B head guide is approximate because a hand occludes the chin; the artistic verdict does not rely on the guide alone.
